source.title: Stop-loss rules and momentum payoffs in cryptocurrencies
author: Mohsin Sadaqat
Hilal Anwar Butt

extracted_method.source_strategy_context: Cross-sectional momentum with long winner and short loser portfolios.
extracted_method.primary_stop_rule: Within a month, if cumulative loss for an individual cryptocurrency reaches 30%, close/reverse the relevant source-side exposure according to the source portfolio logic.
extracted_method.winner_long_interpretation: For a long winner, a cumulative loss of 30% within the month activates the stop-loss and sells/closes that cryptocurrency.
extracted_method.loser_short_interpretation: For a short loser, a 30% adverse price increase activates the stop-loss and closes/buys the cryptocurrency.

yatl_adaptation_draft.scope: Risk overlay only; it may not create entries.
yatl_adaptation_draft.exit_rule: Close an open long when point-in-time cumulative loss from its recorded entry reaches the frozen stop threshold.
yatl_adaptation_draft.next_step: Preregister a bounded standalone Development protocol comparing an unmodified underlying candidate with stop thresholds selected from a frozen small grid.
yatl_adaptation_draft.source_fidelity: ADAPTED_OVERLAY: preserves the ex-ante loss-threshold idea; source cross-sectional short-leg mechanics are excluded.
